behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Assert subview byte boundaries and copy isolation.
Assert serial awaiting, source snapshot before first await, exact metadata and stop on first failure.
docDelivery: Document core byte-copy boundaries and domain.
Describe transport injection, eager snapshot, ordering and error/no-retry semantics.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Bounded non-shared Uint8Array byte views, pure copy chunks and serial injected async transport with exact errors.
manualBehavior: upload delegates byte chunk formation to core; no duplicate chunk algorithm or ambient transport.
independence: Separate chunk formation from upload transport preserving byte order, chunk bounds and first-failure behavior.
